payload.evidence_against: The exact HMM public notebook reports only a small-well comparison; our first local screens found severe 16-28 RMSE HMM catastrophes; E010 found no unique full-data oracle wins from the HMM family; public composite notebooks depend on pretrained, overlap, contact, and unknown-license artifacts that cannot enter a prize pipeline.
payload.evidence_for: A score-blind fold-stratified 20-well probe gave E011 12.9126 RMSE, the exact second-order HMM 12.5865, and a fixed 50/50 blend 9.5685 with row-error correlation 0.1359. A separate first-12-well probe gave 12.4440, 10.7663, and 9.7453. This is multi-point complementary signal, not a hundredth-level selector effect.
payload.next_test: Complete T038 exactly: audit four second-order HMM variants, one likelihood-PF branch, fixed global blends, legal observable-edge wells, and full evidence-destruction/determinism/missing-data controls. Escalate only if a fixed candidate gains at least 1.0 RMSE with broad fold and tail support.
payload.statement: Independent public trajectory mechanisms, especially exact second-order HMM smoothing and likelihood-weighted PF, contain complementary legal whole-tail shape signal that can combine with E011 for a multi-RMSE gain without overlap, contact lookup, formations, pretrained artifacts, score-derived constants, or hidden routing.
payload.title: Public trajectory mechanisms add complementary legal shape signal
